Gebruik steeds dezelfde frequentie range als bij het trainen van het model.
```{r set frequency range}
min.freq <- 200
max.freq <- 3900
```

```{r libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(gibbonR)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r Load trained model}
trained_model <- readRDS("./output/trained_model.rda")
```

```{r set directory}
testing <- menu(choices = c("test", "real"), 
                title = "Kies een optie", 
                graphics = TRUE)

# for testing
if(testing == 1){
  TestFileDirectory <- "./input/testdata"
  OutputDirectory <- "./output/testdata"
} else {
  if(testing == 2){
    TestFileDirectory <- "./input/onbekend"
    OutputDirectory <- "./output/onbekend"
  }else{
    stop("run gecancelled")
  }
}
```

Wanneer de output directory nog niet bestaat, maak deze aan.
```{r create output directory}
if(!dir.exists(OutputDirectory)){
  dir.create(OutputDirectory, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

Wanneer er nog "resultaten" in de output directory staan, verwijder deze.
```{r remove old results}
if(length(list.files(OutputDirectory)) > 0){
  verwijder <- askYesNo(msg = "Er staan nog resultaten in de output directory. Wil je deze verwijderen?")
  if(verwijder){
    file.remove(list.files(OutputDirectory, full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE))
  }
}
```

```{r}
gibbonR(input=TestFileDirectory,
        input.type = "directory",
        feature.df = trained_model,
        model.type.list = c('SVM','RF'),
        tune = TRUE,
        short.wav.duration = 300,
        target.signal = c("klauwkikker"),
        min.freq = min.freq, max.freq = max.freq,
        noise.quantile.val = 0.15,
        minimum.separation = 3,
        n.windows = 9, num.cep = 12,
        spectrogram.window = 160,
        pattern.split = ".wav",
        min.signal.dur = 1,
        max.sound.event.dur = 25,
        maximum.separation = 1,
        probability.thresh.svm = 0.6,
        probability.thresh.rf = 0.6,
        wav.output = "TRUE",
        output.dir = OutputDirectory,
        swift.time = TRUE,
        time.start = 0,
        time.stop = 25,
        write.table.output=TRUE,
        verbose=TRUE,
        random.sample='NA')
```

```{r}
# read txt files in output directory
results <- list.files(OutputDirectory, pattern = ".txt", full.names = TRUE) %>% 
  map_dfr(read_tsv)

# filter results
results_likely <- results %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = `File Name`, 
              names_from = model.type, 
              values_from = probability,
              values_fn = mean) %>% 
  filter(SVM <= 0.9 & RF > 0.7 | SVM > 0.9 | RF > 0.725)

results_unlikely <- results %>% 
  anti_join(results_likely, by = "File Name")

# create likely/unlikely folders
likely_dir <- file.path(OutputDirectory, "likely")
unlikely_dir <- file.path(OutputDirectory, "unlikely")

if(!dir.exists(likely_dir)){
  dir.create(likely_dir)
}

if(!dir.exists(unlikely_dir)){
  dir.create(unlikely_dir)
}

# move files to likely/unlikely folders
for(f in results_likely$`File Name`){
  cat(f, "\n")
  filelist <- list.files(OutputDirectory, pattern = f, full.names = TRUE) 
  
  file <- subset(filelist, grepl(".wav", filelist))
  
  test <- as.data.frame(file) %>% 
    mutate(export_filename = gsub(pattern = "_SVM", replacement = "", x = file),
           export_filename = gsub(pattern = "_RF", replacement = "", x = export_filename),
           export_filename = substr(export_filename, 0, nchar(export_filename)-9),
           export_filename = gsub("_+$", "", export_filename),
           export_filename = paste0(export_filename, ".wav"),
           export_filename = gsub(pattern = OutputDirectory, replacement = "", x = export_filename)) %>% 
    group_by(export_filename) %>% 
    summarise(file = first(file))
  
  # Copy the first file to the likely directory
  for(e in test$file){
    export_filename <- test$export_filename[which(test$file == e)]
    
    file <- subset(file, !grepl(e, file))
    
    file.copy(e, file.path(likely_dir, export_filename))
    file.remove(e)
  }
  # Remove the other likely files
  for(e in file){
    file.remove(e)
  }
}



for(f in results_unlikely$`File Name`){
  cat(f, "\n")
  filelist <- list.files(OutputDirectory, pattern = f, full.names = TRUE) 
  
  file <- subset(filelist, grepl(".wav", filelist))
  
  test <- as.data.frame(file) %>% 
    mutate(export_filename = gsub(pattern = "_SVM", replacement = "", x = file),
           export_filename = gsub(pattern = "_RF", replacement = "", x = export_filename),
           export_filename = substr(export_filename, 0, nchar(export_filename)-9),
           export_filename = gsub("_+$", "", export_filename),
           export_filename = paste0(export_filename, ".wav"),
           export_filename = gsub(pattern = OutputDirectory, replacement = "", x = export_filename)) %>% 
    group_by(export_filename) %>% 
    summarise(file = first(file))
  
  # Copy the first file to the likely directory
  for(e in test$file){
    export_filename <- test$export_filename[which(test$file == e)]
    
    file <- subset(file, !grepl(e, file))
    
    file.copy(e, file.path(unlikely_dir, export_filename))
    file.remove(e)
  }
  # Remove the other likely files
  for(e in file){
    file.remove(e)
  }
}
```
